verdict.rationale: Running a local LLM is a fair question for a desktop CPU platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never states a maximum addressable system memory, a published memory bandwidth figure, or any 70B-class inference result. The 208MB 3D V-Cache, EXPO memory overclocking and generic 'AI experiences' marketing are adjacent features, not evidence that the platform delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run a large local LLM (70B-class, quantized) on this platform — enough addressable memory and published memory bandwidth to make local inference practical
